en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside industrial complex with a tall smokestack in the foreground and a large hill covered in trees behind it. On top of the hill stands a fortified medieval complex with walls, towers, and buildings, identified as Schloss Mildenstein. The scene is reflected in the calm river. Red printed German text appears at the top and along the right edge.
